name: Hannes
source:
A faithful butler who protects Xion's side. He is mostly next to Xion, but his room is somewhere downstairs. Sometimes he acts excessively when working what has been assigned to him. He pretends to be kind, but his specialty is to spit out harsh words while smiling. Since he finds castle life boring and unimaginative, he usually wanders around the castle and talks to people.

[From [url=https://apps.apple.com/us/app/bride-of-the-twilight/id1598260899]English App Store[/url]]
